_readme.about: Every headline ever kept, one file per month of publication. Headlines are only added, never removed; one rejected by today's rules is kept with filtered: true.

fields.items: The headlines of that month, newest first. Each item: see 'headline fields'.

item_fields.id: Permanent id: the first 16 hex digits of the SHA-1 of the normalised title. Never reused.
item_fields.title: The headline as published (control characters removed).
item_fields.link: Link to the article through Google News; only http(s) links are kept.
item_fields.source: The outlet's name as Google News gives it.
item_fields.feed: Archive only. Which feed or backfill query found the headline.
item_fields.snippet: Archive only, when the feed gave one: the outlet line under the headline.
item_fields.category: Topic: the first matching rule in fetch_news.CATEGORY_RULES (Cancelled / Blocked first, General when none).
item_fields.tags: Archive only. Every topic rule that matched, primary first.
item_fields.locations: Archive only. Up to three U.S. places found, most precise first: {name, lat, lon, level, precision, country}.
item_fields.states: Every two-letter U.S. state the headline is placed in.
item_fields.state: The main state (from the most precise place), or absent.
item_fields.county: Archive only. The county or parish named, as 'Name County, State, US'.
item_fields.location_precision: Archive only. city, county, state, or source (only the outlet's home state was known).
item_fields.companies: Operators: companies that own, develop or run data centers (fetch_news.COMPANIES).
item_fields.capacity_mw: Capacity stated in the title, in megawatts (gigawatts converted); absent when none or above 20,000 MW.
item_fields.investment_usd_b: Investment stated in the title, in billions of U.S. dollars.
item_fields.name_hint: Archive only. A project name in the title ('Project Sail', 'Wildcat Ridge Data Center'), used for matching.
item_fields.cluster_id: The story this headline belongs to: the id of the story's earliest headline.
item_fields.cluster_title: Archive only. The story's display headline (the one with the most precise place).
item_fields.cluster_lead: news.json only. true on the story's display headline (replaces cluster_title there).
item_fields.filtered: Archive only. true when today's rules reject the headline (off topic, foreign, blocked outlet); kept, never shown.
